record.paper_title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties
record.context_brief: Structure theorem for singular klt pairs
record.original_question: For klt projective pairs (X,Δ) with nef anti-canonical divisor −(K_X+Δ), without assuming that X is smooth, can one establish a structure theorem analogous to the smooth case? In the smooth case the desired structure includes a holomorphic MRC fibration φ: X → Y to a smooth projective variety Y with numerically trivial canonical divisor, local triviality of the pair (X,Δ) over Y, and a universal-cover product decomposition by the universal cover of Y and the typical fiber.

artifact.status_search_result: A structure theorem along these lines has been established in significant generality. Cao–Höring (and subsequent work by Ejiri–Gongyo, Wang, and others) prove that for projective klt pairs with nef anti-log-canonical divisor, after a finite quasi-étale cover, $X$ admits a locally trivial rationally connected fibration onto a klt projective variety with numerically trivial canonical divisor. Combined with singular Beauville–Bogomolov decomposition results for Calabi–Yau varieties, this yields a decomposition into rationally connected and Calabi–Yau/hyperkähler building blocks. The fully unconditional statement (without passing to a cover, with $\varphi$ holomorphic and universal-cover splitting in complete analogy to the smooth case) is not fully established in all generality, so the problem is best classified as partially solved.

status_evidence.claim: A structure theorem is proved for projective klt pairs with nef anti-canonical divisor, generalizing the smooth case.
